tool.name: Biomni: Analyze Endolysosomal Calcium Dynamics
tool.description: Analyze calcium dynamics in endo-lysosomal compartments using ELGA/ELGA1 probe data.
tool.command:
python -c " import sys import json from biomni.tool.physiology import analyze_endolysosomal_calcium_dynamics
# Parse arguments args = {} i = 1 while i < len(sys.argv): if sys.argv[i].startswith('--'): key = sys.argv[i][2:] if i + 1 < len(sys.argv) and not sys.argv[i + 1].startswith('--'): val = sys.argv[i + 1] # Type conversion if val.lower() == 'true': val = True elif val.lower() == 'false': val = False else: try: val = int(val) except: try: val = float(val) except: pass args[key] = val i += 2 else: args[key] = True i += 1 else: i += 1
# Call function result = analyze_endolysosomal_calcium_dynamics(**args)
# Write output output_path = args.get('output', '/dev/stdout') with open(output_path, 'w') as f: if isinstance(result, str): f.write(result) elif isinstance(result, (dict, list)): json.dump(result, f, indent=2, default=str) else: f.write(str(result)) " --output '$output' --time_points '$time_points' --luminescence_values '$luminescence_values' #if $treatment_time --treatment_time '$treatment_time' #end if #if $cell_type --cell_type '$cell_type' #end if #if $treatment_name --treatment_name '$treatment_name' #end if #if $output_file --output_file '$output_file' #end if

param.name: time_points
param.label: Time Points
param.help: Time points of the measurements in seconds

param.name: luminescence_values
param.label: Luminescence Values
param.help: Luminescence intensity values from ELGA/ELGA1 probes corresponding to Ca2+ levels

param.name: treatment_time
param.label: Treatment Time
param.help: Time point (in seconds) when treatment/stimulus was applied

param.name: cell_type
param.label: Cell Type
param.help: Type of cells used in the experiment

param.name: treatment_name
param.label: Treatment Name
param.help: Name of the treatment or stimulus applied

param.name: output_file
param.label: Output File
param.help: Name of the file to save detailed analysis results

tool.help:
**Biomni: Analyze Endolysosomal Calcium Dynamics**
Analyze calcium dynamics in endo-lysosomal compartments using ELGA/ELGA1 probe data.
Parameters ---------- time_points : numpy.ndarray or list Time points of the measurements in seconds luminescence_values : numpy.ndarray or list Luminescence intensity values from ELGA/ELGA1 probes corresponding to Ca2+ levels treatment_time : float, optional Time point (in seconds) when treatment/stimulus was applied cell_type : str, optional Type of cells used in the experiment treatment_name : str, optional Name of the treatment or stimulus applied output_file : str, optional Name of the file to save detailed analysis results
Returns ------- str A research log summarizing the calcium dynamics analysis and key findings
**Domain**: physiology **Function**: analyze_endolysosomal_calcium_dynamics
